plan.purpose: Find incremental signals that improve net, feasible third-and-later reverse-split shorts while controlling tail loss and data selection.

baseline_definition.count_by: SEC issuer ID; distinct effective dates; prior actions publicly known before decision
baseline_definition.entry: First eligible session after effective-day close and source availability + five minutes; features frozen before order submission.

plan.primary_sizing: Conditional 1% prior share ADV and recorded execution-volume caps; 0.1% and 5% sensitivities; full $25k is a separate benchmark.

signals.name: Cash pressure
signals.rule: Negative TTM operating cash flow and cash runway below six months.
signals.requirements: As-filed unrestricted cash, consistent currency and public-clock evidence; adjust for confirmed cash proceeds/uses since the balance date without double counting. Unknown pro forma funding => runway unknown.
signals.status: Cached raw runway coverage 142/210; 141 satisfy the initial freshness/public-clock check; pro forma audit pending.

signals.name: Recent dilutive financing
signals.rule: Completed equity-linked financing publicly disclosed in the preceding 60 calendar days, with independently reconciled issuance/security class.
signals.requirements: Distinguish actual issuance and saleable supply from authorization, registration capacity, amendments and boilerplate; preserve transaction IDs, cash proceeds, lockups and availability dates.
signals.status: 48 cached source leads and 137 provider flags; zero independently verified terms. Audit required before selection.

signals.name: Rapid repeat splitting
signals.rule: Previous distinct reverse split effective no more than 180 calendar days before the current split.
signals.requirements: Same issuer and security class; deduplicate date conflicts; incomplete earlier history remains flagged.
signals.status: Derivable from existing action catalogues; historical identity review pending.

signals.name: Actual share dilution
signals.rule: At least 25% growth in split-adjusted end-of-period common shares over the preceding six months.
signals.requirements: Use latest public comparable observations; prior observation within 150–240 days of latest period; same share class, consolidated basis and denominator type. Never mix weighted-average EPS shares or double-adjust restated shares.
signals.status: Extract from cached filing facts; coverage and restatement audit pending.

signals.name: Weak split-day close
signals.rule: Completed effective-day close below its open and in the bottom quarter of the day's high-low range.
signals.requirements: Only use a complete public bar before entry. Missing or zero-range bars are unknown. Next eligible session entry; no intrabar or VWAP claims.
signals.status: Existing daily nominal bars; must validate price provenance and action units.

signals.name: Existing price weakness
signals.rule: Mechanically adjusted close-to-close return over the last 20 completed sessions at or below -20%.
signals.requirements: All observations precede submission; full split/ADS adjustment path; no total-return claim without distributions.
signals.status: Existing daily cache; missing intervals and action conflicts remain unknown.

signals.name: Squeeze-risk veto
signals.rule: Skip if any mechanically adjusted close-to-close rise in the last five completed sessions was at least 50%.
signals.requirements: Uses only prior observations; no exclusions based on subsequent squeezes or named losing stocks.
signals.status: Existing daily cache; hypothesis rather than an established safeguard.
signals.pass_semantics: S7 passes when the veto condition is NOT triggered; missing five-session history is unknown, not safe.

combinations.rule: S1 AND S2 AND S7 passes
S1 AND S2 AND S5 AND S7 passes
S5 AND S6 AND S7 passes

plan.threshold_policy: One fixed threshold per signal; no outcome-driven grid. Any alternative threshold requires a dated amendment and is explicitly another tested hypothesis.
plan.missing_data: Three states: pass/fail/unknown. Feature-specific covered-universe baseline and full-universe exclusion funnel; absence of cached evidence is not a negative fact.

chronology.walk_forward: Select at most two rules using only prior completed labels; quarter-by-quarter replay. At least 30 training issuers; otherwise retain baseline. Purge unfinished/overlapping label paths and embargo at least 20 sessions. Unresolved outcomes never become completed training labels.
chronology.historical_status: All these years are already explored development history. No retrospective split is described as an untouched holdout.
chronology.prospective: Freeze selected rules and hashes before the first future enrollment; an outcome never examined after registration is the real validation.

execution.primary: Conditional daily proxies; 1% share ADV participation; 0.1% and 5% reported separately. Prior share ADV in entry-day units. Current-day volume constrains simulated execution only and is not a pre-entry predictor.
execution.borrow: No historical approved quantity reconstructed from ADV. Verified-borrow replay stays zero until timestamped evidence exists. Log locate fee, APR, quantity, recalls and loan return prospectively.
execution.costs: Reuse existing 20/50/150% APR and execution/depth scenarios; frozen dated fee schedule. Report missing dividends, servicing, locate and recall obligations; do not rank on a zero-cost benchmark.
execution.SSR: Strict restricted/unknown skip comparator; passive-compliant conditional route only with adequate quote/execution evidence. Never assume any auction or VWAP order is automatically exempt.
execution.accounting: Retain delayed/fractional covers, unresolved liabilities, mechanical actions, stale marks and post-cover loan carry; do not drop unavailable exits.
execution.risk: Use identical declared research-account constraints for every rule; production policy stays frozen. Reuse current +200% price-rise stress, 0.5% NAV per-name loss reserve and 2% NAV sleeve reserve: nominal per-name <=0.25% NAV and aggregate sleeve <=1% NAV before other strategy reservations. Full $25k is a separate hypothetical benchmark. Verified execution and thesis/cost gates are reported separately, not silently relaxed.
execution.SPX: Offline analysis only. No Gateway calls, production policy edits, automatic orders or new recurring sessions.

reporting: Incremental net portfolio P&L and capital use versus same-policy baseline
Same-covered-universe comparisons to separate feature effect from missingness
Trade/issuer counts, filled dollars, coverage and all rejections
Issuer and calendar-block uncertainty on incremental results
Worst trade/day, drawdown, per-trade adverse excursion and high-price stress
Closed versus unresolved P&L and liability aging
Holm adjustment across 11 primary incremental claims; log every secondary experiment

promotion.historical_minimum: At least 30 independent issuers in the selected evaluable sample; smaller cells remain descriptive.
promotion.required: Positive incremental net result under realistic modeled capacity, uncertainty and family-wise correction; no deterioration in declared tail budget; not dependent on one winner, missing exits or one calendar block. Report trade count and capital reduction alongside total P&L.
promotion.forward_gate: At least 50 independently sourced eligible issuer decisions and 30 different issuers, with a fully logged shadow execution ledger; this is a minimum review point, not statistical proof. Extend enrollment until precision on realized net edge and tail loss is adequate. No automatic production promotion.

sequence: Reproduce previous baseline and lock source hashes, protocol and experiment register.
Audit as-of feature coverage; reconcile financing flags, actual proceeds, share units and prior actions.
Run seven single signals and four fixed combinations against both baselines, with shared maturity/exit rules.
Apply chronological diagnostics, uncertainty, multiple-test correction and capacity/tail comparisons; retain at most two research finalists.
Test a separate delayed-confirmation timing arm and conservative next-session-open risk exits only for finalists, with matching delay/exit baselines; do not assume stop prices fill through gaps.
Freeze a forward shadow protocol and enrollment ledger; no live orders or scheduled broker collection.
unavailable_features: Intraday VWAP/queue fills across all events
plan.data_outputs_public: Aggregated results and protocol only; licensed per-event returns and source ledgers remain local.
plan.primary_objective: Maximize incremental net portfolio P&L at the same account capital and stress budget, subject to no worse declared tail-loss/drawdown limit; report the profit/drawdown/capacity frontier. Improved mean return alone is not success.
diagnostics_required: Ordinal 3, 4 and 5+ strata; these are descriptive controls, not extra thresholds selected after seeing returns.
Cached financing flag versus independently reconciled deal; post-financing pro forma runway versus stale reported runway.
Stricter data-identity and source-clock versions; repairs known only later cannot become decision features.

amendment_before_new_returns: Use a declared $1m reference NAV for the fixed-budget primary; it is not an assertion about the user account.
Restricted/unknown SSR is skipped in the primary. Legacy 50% passive capture is an unsupported execution sensitivity, not verified fills.
Source leads remain unverified until two independent outcome-blinded source-bound reviews are imported.
No historical research promotion while any selected position is unresolved; this is a stricter evidence gate, not an inferred zero-value exit.
A 20% completed-close risk exit and up-to-three-bar failed-rebound test are implemented, but run only for finalists.
S1 is conditional on cached funding coverage; any observed unresolved financing blocks pro forma selection.
implementation.rule_thresholds: Exactly the seven original fixed thresholds; no threshold search.
